name: Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund
oneLiner: BENJI is the on-chain share token for Franklin Templeton's FOBXX, an SEC-registered U.S. government money market fund with a stable $1.00 NAV.
collateral: U.S. government securities, cash, and repurchase agreements held by the Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund (FOBXX); '40 Act-registered money market fund custodied by BNY Mellon with Franklin Templeton as transfer agent and Benji as the on-chain share record
pegMechanism: Single fund, multi-chain BENJI token tracking FOBXX's stable $1.00 NAV; rebasing share count records distributed yield directly on-chain; subscriptions and redemptions are gated to KYC-verified Benji wallets with USD-wire and Benji-to-USDC settlement paths

notices.title: Multi-chain fund with limited on-chain telemetry
notices.message: BENJI is the multi-chain share token of Franklin Templeton's FOBXX money market fund. Pharos tracks the Ethereum, Stellar, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Aptos, Base, and Solana deployments; BNB Chain and Canton issuances are not yet integrated. Live reserves use a curated weekly snapshot of the official fund factsheet until an on-chain NAV oracle becomes available.

mintAuthority.summary: BENJI is the on-chain share record for Franklin Templeton's FOBXX SEC-registered government money market fund; Franklin Templeton acts as transfer agent, minting/burning shares to KYC-verified Benji wallets on subscription and redemption.

controls.label: Franklin Templeton transfer-agent issuance
controls.evidence: Franklin Templeton operates Benji as FOBXX's transfer agent, recording share issuance and redemption on-chain and rebasing share counts for yield; transfers are restricted to KYC-verified holders and the issuer holds freeze/burn authority. No permissionless mint route exists.

review.evidence: Franklin Templeton materials describe BENJI as the on-chain share record of the '40-Act-registered FOBXX fund with Franklin as transfer agent controlling permissioned issuance, freeze, and burn; no user-collateralized or permissionless mint exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer/transfer-agent model established from Franklin Templeton materials; per-chain on-chain token owner/minter admin not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain token owner/minter admin across Aptos, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, and Stellar before raising confidence.
